svg.title: Spelling-Spells — spellbook and wand concepts v6
svg.desc: Four concepts: refined selected A, wands parallel to its legs, two upright parallel wands, and S with pale wand tips. All use compact centered mirrored calligraphy within the lavender book.

g.text: SPELLBOOK & WAND EXPLORATIONS / V6

Centered calligraphy, mirrored wand pairs, and a new S direction.

Parallel Wand Pair
